hook.narration: Three study hacks that actually work the night before an exam.

beats.narration: One. Close your notes and write down everything you remember. That's active recall.
Two. Study in 25 minute blocks with 5 minute breaks.
Three. Teach it out loud like you're explaining it to a friend.

cta.narration: Our app turns your notes into flashcards automatically.
cta.onScreen: Turn notes into flashcards in seconds
